What's New in 1.5.5-beta2 (Watch Screen v3 — Concept 1):
1. Quick Episode Action Strip directly below the classic 16:9 player:
   - ‹ Prev | Episode N • Title | Next › | glowing ✦ Auto-Next toggle pill (synced with PlaybackPanel & SharedPreferences).
2. Compact Server Switcher card:
   - Segmented SUB | DUB tabs with live server counts + horizontal scrollable server chips (● Server 1 • Fast, 5/page + Other servers ›).
   - Collapsible ⚙ Tools drawer (PlaybackPanel, ⚙ Advanced video enhancements, ⛶ Enhanced fullscreen) + ⓘ Diagnostics trigger.
3. Upgraded 3-Row Episode Playlist card:
   - 16:9 episode thumbnails (AniList streamingEpisodes + Crunchyroll/TMDB/TVDB/banner artwork), episode number badge, watched/resume progress bar, and Now Playing / amber FILLER / RECAP / ✓ Watched pills, plus "See all ›" inline height toggle & instant search.
4. Upgraded Anime Details card + horizontal 16:9 More Anime shelf:
   - Live ★ X.X/10 score badge and genre chips, expandable synopsis, and smooth horizontal recommendation cards.
5. Classic Video Player Restored:
   - Original clean player controls preserved across embedded, HLS, native, and offline playback; official GitHub Release remains untouched on v1.5.4.
